The query is a well-specified math problem with a single correct answer — exactly the kind of task where raw capability matters most. Willet-235B has clearly stronger benchmark scores (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 56.2) and higher internal eval scores across the board, including reasoning-relevant areas.

The user also explicitly wants a concise, no-rambling answer, which is an instruction-following demand — and Willet leads on IFEval (89.8 vs 85.3). The task preference notes (aversion to open-ended work, desensitization to distasteful content) are irrelevant here since this is a benign, closed-form question, and the documentation stresses that preferences are dissociated from quality anyway.

So I routed on capability, and Willet is the stronger model for this task.
